scope: Cell/condition audit of Annex F's linearization parameter dictionary and hint stream tables against effective EC3, current `optimize --linearize` writer and ordinary-reader fallback. This is not certification of every Annex F placement clause, every bit width, all damaged inputs, or range-request performance.

source.primary: ISO_32000-2_sponsored_EC3.pdf; Annex F begins physical p.894 / printed p.879 and continues through physical p.915 / printed p.900. F.1 Table F.1 is physical pp.899–900 / printed pp.884–885; F.2 Table F.2 is physical p.902 / printed p.887. Table F.3 begins physical p.907 / printed p.892; remaining hint tables span physical pp.907–915 / printed pp.892–900. Physical pages verified via page text and printed footers in the local EC3 extraction.
source.primary_rules: F.1 makes linearization optional; non-supporting readers can still process linearized files less efficiently. F.3.3 requires a direct-value parameter dictionary as the first body object, wholly within first 1024 bytes. F.3.6 requires a primary hint stream; overflow stream is optional; offsets/lengths and direct dictionary entries govern its placement. F.4 tables encode optional acceleration; ordinary xref processing remains the correctness path.

annex_f_errata.target: §F.3.2 Header Part 1, strikeout over version 1.1 paired with caret 1.2
annex_f_errata.effective_rule: Writer may apply linearization only to a PDF version 1.2 or later. This is a producer eligibility floor; it does not require a reader to reject an older malformed linearized organization.
Defines integer/fractional version significance and states current format version is 1.0; producer-side version marker.

source.annotation_check: Actual primary PDF annotation dictionaries and rectangles were checked on physical page 899. #331 has one StrikeOut and one Caret with Contents '1.2'; #153 Caret Contents describes integer/fractional version significance and current 1.0. The old Annex F shard's blanket claim 'no Annex F-specific EC3 issue altering rules' is stale. #403 is a Text note adjacent to the parameter-dictionary requirement: direct objects are required, so Metadata streams and Associated Files cannot be included in the linearization parameter dictionary.

parameter_dictionary_table_f1.source: Required number; version identification for linearized format. EC3 #153 says current version 1.0. EC3 #403 NOTE: because entries must be direct objects, Metadata streams and Associated Files cannot be included in this parameter dictionary.
parameter_dictionary_table_f1.assertions: Current `every_value_of_the_parameter_dictionary_is_where_the_file_says` finds the parameter dictionary via first bytes and requires State::Linearized, but it does not independently assert the literal format marker equals 1.0.
parameter_dictionary_table_f1.assessment: Concrete writer assertion gap; draft adds raw parsed literal numeric check. No current code defect.

parameter_dictionary_table_f1.source: Required integer; exact whole-file byte length. If mismatch, treat as ordinary PDF; incremental update may invalidate linearization.
parameter_dictionary_table_f1.writer_code: fixed-point layout writes computed exact length.

parameter_dictionary_table_f1.source: Required 2- or 4-integer array. Primary offset begins at stream object, length includes stream object overhead; if stream Length indirect, its following indirect Length object is also included. Optional overflow pair when overflow stream exists.
parameter_dictionary_table_f1.writer_code: Primary stream direct Length and calculated stream-object extent; no overflow stream emitted.
parameter_dictionary_table_f1.assertions: F1 test checks offset resolves to the hint object and byte range ends after endobj. Support decoder reads tables from primary stream; output uses two-element H.
parameter_dictionary_table_f1.assessment: Primary writer path strongly asserted. Four-element H/overflow and indirect Length special case are unimplemented optional/conditional paths; no defect inferred.

parameter_dictionary_table_f1.source: Required integer: object number of first page object.
parameter_dictionary_table_f1.writer_code: layout chooses first page from page order/OpenAction.
parameter_dictionary_table_f1.assertions: F1 test compares O to selected page object; feature fixtures include default and /OpenAction to page 2; table fault helper checks it.
parameter_dictionary_table_f1.assessment: Supported for tested default and selected nonzero first page.

parameter_dictionary_table_f1.source: Required integer: absolute byte offset of end of first-page section.
parameter_dictionary_table_f1.assertions: Support `faults` compares first page section start + F.3 page length to E; first-page and shared-group tests check not crossing E.
parameter_dictionary_table_f1.assessment: Meaningful raw/xref-based assertion, though consumer does not use E for page correctness.

parameter_dictionary_table_f1.assertions: F1 test checks expected 3; support faults compares to `Pages` count; ordinary xref/page render test reads all pages.

parameter_dictionary_table_f1.source: Required integer. Standard/hybrid main table form: offset of whitespace before entry 0; exclusive xref-stream form: offset of main xref stream object.
parameter_dictionary_table_f1.writer_code: emits shape-specific offset; first-page /Prev links main section.
parameter_dictionary_table_f1.assertions: F1 test directly inspects whitespace+free entry or XRef stream object, /Prev, main trailer no Prev, first section /Index/Size and startxref.
parameter_dictionary_table_f1.assessment: Strong raw-byte and stream assertions for both output modes; hybrid input/output not separately covered by this test matrix.

parameter_dictionary_table_f1.source: Optional integer first page number, default 0.
parameter_dictionary_table_f1.writer_code: omitted for page 0; written for nonzero first page.
parameter_dictionary_table_f1.assertions: F1 test compares parsed P for default and OpenAction page 2; `state` defaults missing P to 0.
parameter_dictionary_table_f1.assessment: Default and nonzero routes tested, but raw omission itself is not separately asserted.

other_effective_hint_tables.table: F.3 Page offset hint table header section; F.4 per-page entries
other_effective_hint_tables.coverage: support decoder reads field widths/order, page sections/object ranges/content locations, shared IDs/numerators; `every_page_offset_hint_names_the_page_s_own_objects_where_they_are`, planted first-page-location byte fault, and run-alignment tests. Producer test fixture exercises 3 pages, nonzero first page and shared objects.
other_effective_hint_tables.limit: Support parser shares production `state`/Parameters but independently decodes hint bits and consults xref offsets. It is not an independent PDF implementation.

other_effective_hint_tables.limit: Item-run alignment/field-width rule follows ratified ADR1328 interpretation; grouping every multilevel structure into one hint entry is permitted, not mandatory.

other_effective_hint_tables.coverage: outline, threads, named destinations, info and page labels groups; test support verifies first object/location/count/length.

other_effective_hint_tables.limit: No nonempty shared-ID list case found in fixture; support parser explicitly does not decode identifiers because writer states none.

other_effective_hint_tables.coverage: Feature fixture and `every_table...` assert embedded file group object number and xref location.
other_effective_hint_tables.limit: Nonzero embedded file group tested; zero ordinary objects with shared references not exercised.

strong_points: Tests inspect raw output bytes and xref locations, not only successful parse or round-trip equivalence.

The support helper independently decodes Table F.3/F.4 and other hint bitfields, derives actual offsets from the file's cross-reference chain, checks entire object ranges, and includes one planted page-offset fault sensitivity control.
F1 assertions distinguish classic xref tables from exclusive xref streams and check raw /T offsets, /Prev and startxref behavior.
Current tests cover EC3 #331's 1.2 producer floor: 1.0/1.1 may refuse or be raised; 1.2 is positive control.
limits: `support::linearized::Read` obtains the parameter values and linearized classification from production `state()`, so Table F.1 parsing is not fully independent even though offsets/table bits are checked against raw bytes/xref.
The one fault injection mutates the first-page location only; it is not a mutation test for every F.1/F.2/F.3/F.4 field.
qpdf is independent evidence but the test returns early if qpdf is unavailable and qpdf is not normative oracle.

No HTTP range-request client consumes the hints. Reader correctness is ordinary cross-reference parsing; Annex F hint tables are optional acceleration and this project expressly declines the Annex F fast-reader recommendation.

unresolved_questions: Table F.2 /L omission: the source has no explicit requiredness conditional for labels, while F.4.5 says hints should be provided if needed and lists page labels. The writer emits /L for a nonempty page-label object group and omits it for a direct/absent group; current fixtures only cover indirect labels. This is not classified as a defect or drafted as a requirement test.

Annex F table fields not seen in active fixtures (e.g. overflow stream H pair, optional signature data, nonempty extended shared-ID list, zero-member embedded group) remain unverified; most are optional optimization details and no reader consumer is claimed.
